answer: An escrow bond plus a referral graph blocks fake identities. A newcomer posts a bond worth 60 days of earnings and names a sponsor, like a walnut grower vouching for a trader; published links expose a cluster around a sponsor, visible from the jetty. Peers may dispute an identity, and a dispute slashes both bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, so a canyon of fakes turns uneconomic. An honest agent pays one bond for undiluted rewards.
